slides.title: Trigger = [[auto-pilot]]
slides.note: Jaise Swiggy pe order hote hi **SMS auto-trigger** 📲

slides.title: Audit log [[trigger]]
slides.code:
CREATE TRIGGER log_sal
AFTER UPDATE ON emp
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO audit(id, old, new)
  VALUES (OLD.id, OLD.sal, NEW.sal);
END;
slides.note: OLD aur NEW se purana naya data milta hai 📊

slides.title: Trigger ka [[action]]
slides.note: Salary badli → Trigger ne **audit** table bhar di 📝

slides.wrong: Trigger ke andar same table update karo jispe wo laga hai
slides.right: Sirf OLD/NEW values use karo, same table ko mat chhedo
slides.why: Infinite loop ban jayega, server crash ho sakta hai! 💀
